description:
🌟 Product Overview

Queen of Ayurvedic oils: authentic stone-pressed sesame (Til / Gingelly) oil extracted from mature sesame seeds. Loaded with unique antioxidants Sesamol and Sesamin, vital trace minerals, and deep warming properties.

  • Extracted with traditional stone mill (Kolhu) preserving raw unroasted goodness
  • Packed with powerful natural antioxidants: Sesamol & Sesamin
  • Tridoshic Ayurvedic elixir: balances Vata dosha, promotes joint flexibility
  • Rich in calcium, zinc, Vitamin E and healthy PUFA/MUFA fats
  • Warm golden color and earthy, nutty fragrance

🪵 Traditional Stone-Pressed (Kolhu) Method

Our oils are extracted using time-honored traditional granite stone mills (Kolhu / Lakdi Ghani) rotating at a gentle 14–16 RPM. No chemical solvents, no artificial refining, and zero external heat.

1
Graded Natural Sesame Seeds

Hand-harvested, pesticide-free white and brown sesame seeds cleaned thoroughly.

2
Slow Rhythmic Stone Churning

Seeds are slowly crushed under granite pestles at low speed to prevent oil burning.

3
Natural Low-Temp Seepage

Raw golden sesame oil emerges without any thermal degradation of polyphenols and lignans.

4
Cloth Settling & Filtration

Natural 24-hour gravity settling followed by cloth sieve filtration for pure amber brilliance.

5
Sealed Bottle Packaging

Bottled in food-grade packaging that protects bioactive Sesamol from ambient UV degradation.

🍳 Culinary Uses & Smoke Point

Smoke Point 210°C (410°F)
Shelf Life 9 to 12 Months from packing

Recommended In: South Indian tempering (tadka for Sambar, Rasam, Chutneys), Idli-Podi powder paste, traditional pickles, morning oil pulling (Gandusha), and Abhyanga whole-body massage.

💚 Health & Wellness Benefits

Supports bone mineral density, strengthens gum and oral health, deeply penetrates dermal layers during massage to relieve joint stiffness.

description:
🌟 Product Overview

100% natural stone-pressed virgin coconut oil extracted from fresh sun-dried sulfur-free copra. Packed with Medium Chain Triglycerides (50%+ Lauric Acid) for energy, immunity, skin hydration, and hair care.

  • Stone-pressed from 100% sulfur-free natural sun-dried coconut copra
  • Rich in Medium Chain Triglycerides (MCTs) with 50%+ Lauric Acid
  • Multi-purpose: delicious edible cooking oil, deep hair conditioning & baby massage
  • Subtle sweet aroma and crystal-clear consistency when liquefied
  • Zero chemicals, zero mineral oils, 100% edible and raw

🪵 Traditional Stone-Pressed (Kolhu) Method

Our oils are extracted using time-honored traditional granite stone mills (Kolhu / Lakdi Ghani) rotating at a gentle 14–16 RPM. No chemical solvents, no artificial refining, and zero external heat.

1
Sulfur-Free Coconut Copra

Freshly harvested mature coconuts sun-dried naturally without toxic sulfur smoke treatments.

2
Slow Stone Mashing

Copra is gently sliced and pressed in a stone Kolhu without generating internal friction heat.

3
Pure Virgin Extraction

First-press pure coconut oil flows naturally, preserving delicate medium-chain fatty acids.

4
Micro Cotton Filtration

Filtered through fine multi-layer cotton cloth to separate fine fiber residues without chemical clarification.

5
Fresh Bottling

Poured into clean, airtight bottles preserving the fresh tropical coconut aroma and moisture barrier.

🍳 Culinary Uses & Smoke Point

Smoke Point 177°C (350°F)
Shelf Life 12 Months from packing

Recommended In: South Indian cooking (Avial, Kerala fish roast, Thoran), baking, bulletproof morning coffee, raw drizzling, deep hair scalp massage, and Ayurvedic Gandusha (oil pulling).

💚 Health & Wellness Benefits

Lauric acid converts into monolaurin for antiviral & antibacterial immunity; MCTs provide instant clean brain & metabolic energy.
